Traits.name: Exploit Opening (3/Day)
Traits.text: When making an attack, has Advantage on the attack roll.

Traits.name: Master Tactic
Traits.text: At the start of combat, Erasmus chooses when he acts in the initiative order after all other creatures have rolled initiative.

Actions.name: Greatsword (2)
Actions.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage; target has Disadvantage on attack rolls against creatures other than Erasmus until end of its next turn.

Only 1 attack if using "I'm Right Here"

Actions.name: I'm Right Here
Actions.text: A creature Erasmus can see within 5 ft. that can hear him must succeed on DC 15 Wisdom save or use its Reaction, if available, to attack Erasmus. If it attacks, an ally within 30 ft. can make a weapon attack against it (no action required).

Actions.name: Iron Ring
Actions.text: 2/day. Teleport to the Cyst if not in it; if in the Cyst, teleport to a place he has visited.

BonusActions.name: Mark
BonusActions.text: Choose a creature within 60 ft.; until start of next turn, first time an ally deals damage to marked creature, it takes an extra 3 (1d6) damage.

BonusActions.name: Reposition
BonusActions.text: Erasmus and each ally within 60 ft. that can hear him move up to 5 ft. without provoking opportunity attacks.

LegendaryActions.name: Playtime's Over
LegendaryActions.text: A High Command member within 60 ft of Erasmus that can hear him can use their villain action even if they already used it.

Description: BIP field leader. Protects the Supervisor early, marks a high-value target, and uses the Master Tactic timing to coordinate the Pact. Do not retreat until at least one BIP member has fallen. Iron Ring 2/day.
